'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq and Syria]]
**A [[United States Air Force]] [[General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper|MQ-9 Reaper]] is shot down in [[international airspace]] off the coast of [[Yemen]]. The [[Iran]]-backed [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim responsibility for the shooting. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-s-mq-9-drone-shot-down-off-yemen-coast/ (CBS News)]
**Two [[United States|U.S.]] [[McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle|F-15]]s strike an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] weapons storage facility in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], [[Syria]], according to the [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]]. [https://theatlasnews.co/conflict/2023/11/08/defsec-lloyd-austin-confirms-airstrikes-against-irgc-target-in-syria/ (''The Atlas News'')]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Al-Shifa ambulance airstrike]]
***[[Human Rights Watch]] says that an [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] on an [[ambulance]] outside the [[Al-Shifa Hospital]] in [[Gaza City]] should be investigated as a possible [[war crime]], adding that it did not find evidence that the ambulance was being used for military purposes. [https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/11/07/gaza-israeli-ambulance-strike-apparently-unlawful (Human Rights Watch)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)] 
**[[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes]]
***Four people are killed in an airstrike on a house in the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] in northern Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)]
**An independent [[United Nations]] expert says that widespread and systematic bombardment of housing and [[civilian]] [[infrastructure]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] amounts to a [[war crime]] and a [[crime against humanity]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/massive-destruction-of-gaza-housing-a-war-crime-un-expert-54209488 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
**[[Amnesty International]] says that Israel has heavily increased its use of [[administrative detention|detention without charges]] since the start of the war, while also allowing [[torture]] and degrading treatment in prisons. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)]
**At least 4,237 Palestinian children have been killed in Gaza since the start of the war. An additional 1,350 children are reported as missing and most are presumed dead under the rubble of destroyed buildings in Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)]
**Israeli aircraft renew their bombardment of the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in central Gaza, resulting in at least 18 deaths. A residence belonging to a local family is also hit, with people trapped under the rubble. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)] 
**Gaza's Al-Shifa Hospital is hit with intense Israeli bombardment and flares. The hospital is housing tens of thousands of people sheltering from Israel's bombardment. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)]
**Sites near the [[Indonesia Hospital]] are hit with Israeli bombardment. Electricity at the hospital is expected to be [[power outage|cut off]] soon due to the short supply of fuel. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)][https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/139101 (WAFA)]
*[[Afghan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***[[November 2023 Kabul bombing]]
****Seven people are killed and 20 others injured when a bomb planted by [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] militants [[explode]]s on a bus carrying [[Shia Islam|Shiites]] in [[Kabul]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mini-bus-blast-shiite-neighborhood-west-kabul-3892f9fc6c3d7484ee4b335b5b7f10b8 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***[[Myanmar]]'s [[Chairman of the State Administration Council|junta leader]] [[Min Aung Hlaing]] calls up all [[Tatmadaw|military]] [[reservist]]s to prepare for military operations to counter the recent offensives by [[Three Brotherhood Alliance|rebel forces]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/myanmar-junta-calls-up-all-reservists-as-resistance-offensive-spreads.html (Irrawaddy)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] strike on a [[Liberia]]n-flagged vessel entering the [[Pivdennyi Port]] in [[Odesa Oblast]] kills one crew member and injures four others. The vessel was being used to transport [[iron ore]] to [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russian-missile-hits-vessel-black-sea-kills-one-2023-11-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**At least 30 pro-[[Government of Syria|government]] [[National Defence Forces|militia forces]] and [[Syrian Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed in a series of attacks by the [[Islamic State]] (IS) near the cities of [[Deir ez-Zor]], [[Homs]], and [[Raqqa]], with [[Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war|Russian]] [[airstrike]]s targeting the IS positions in response. [https://www.barrons.com/news/is-attacks-kill-30-pro-government-forces-in-syria-monitor-8ba3e4d6 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Geneina]]
***[[Ardamata massacre]]
****At least 2,000 people are killed and 3,000 more are injured when the [[Rapid Support Forces]] [[massacre]] [[civilian]]s in the Ardamata neighborhood of [[Geneina]], [[West Darfur]], following the [[Sudanese Army]]'s withdrawal from the town. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/rsf-seize-north-darfur-garrison-reportedly-commit-mass-atrocities-in-west-darfur (Radio Dabanga)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/darfur-refugees-report-new-spate-ethnically-driven-killings-2023-11-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The Rapid Support Forces capture the Sudanese Army [[military base|base]] in [[Umm Keddada]], [[North Darfur]], after the army withdraws. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/rsf-seize-north-darfur-garrison-reportedly-commit-mass-atrocities-in-west-darfur (Radio Dabanga)]
***Experts and activists warn that the entirety of [[Darfur]] is close to being seized by the Rapid Support Forces, with North Darfur remaining the last state in the region under [[government of Sudan|government]] control. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/8/sudans-rsf-closes-in-on-capturing-all-of-darfur (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2023 SAG-AFTRA strike]]
**[[SAG-AFTRA]] and the [[Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers]] reach a tentative agreement to end the [[strike action|strike]]. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/hollywood-reacts-tentative-sag-aftra-amptp-deal-1235642659/# (''The Hollywood Reporter'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 Optus outage]]
**A [[Telecommunications in Australia|telecommunications]] outage by [[Optus]] leaves more than 10 million people in [[Australia]] without [[internet]] and mobile phone service for more than nine hours. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/australias-optus-hit-by-national-network-outage-2023-11-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Zimbabwe]] imposes [[import quota]]s on fertilizer and cement at five metric tons per entity, effective until the year ends, due to [[shortage]]s of the two commodities. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20231109/b740a4237cb545819d28a300ef52335b/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and incidents'''
*Eight people are killed in a [[car crash]] on a [[highway]] in [[Zavala County]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna124243 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Chad]] withdraws their [[ambassador]] from [[Israel]], becoming the eighth country to do so in recent weeks. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/06/africa/south-africa-chad-recall-diplomats-from-israel-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Belgium]]'s deputy prime minister [[Petra De Sutter]] calls on the [[Belgian government]] to adopt [[economic sanctions]] against Israel and investigate the bombings of hospitals and [[refugee camp]]s in Gaza. [https://www.reuters.com/world/belgium-wants-sanctions-against-israel-gaza-bombings-deputy-pm-2023-11-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**The [[Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project]] reports that 4,200 [[political demonstration|demonstrations]] related to the [[Israel-Hamas war]] have been held around the world. 52% of the protests held were in [[North Africa]] and the [[Middle East]] and 90% of the protests were in support of [[State of Palestine|Palestine]]. [https://acleddata.com/2023/11/07/infographic-global-demonstrations-in-response-to-the-israel-palestine-conflict/ (ACLED)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/8/israel-hamas-war-live-humanitarian-aid-targeted-amid-gaza-bombardment (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Turkish constitutional crisis]]
**Turkish [[Court of Cassation (Turkey)|Court of Cassation]] annuls a ruling by [[Constitutional Court of Turkey|the Constitutional Court of Turkey]] ordering the release of {{ill|Can Atalay|tr}}, an imprisoned member of [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Turkish Parliament]], and calls for a criminal investigation into the Constitutional Court members who signed the release order. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-top-appeals-court-files-complaint-against-constitutional-court-judges-2023-11-08/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United Kingdom]] bans the [[recreational use of nitrous oxide]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-67344299 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**UK [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] [[member of parliament|MP]] [[Imran Hussain (British politician)|Imran Hussain]] resigns as [[shadow minister]] for the New Deal for Working People over [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|party leader]] [[Keir Starmer]]'s position on the war, saying "I believe the party needs to go further and call for a [[ceasefire]]". [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2023/nov/08/imran-hussain-labour-frontbencher-resigns-gaza-ceasefire (''The Guardian'')] 
*The [[Holy See]]'s [[Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith]] confirms that [[Christianity and transgender people|transgender]] [[Catholics]] can be [[baptized]] "if it would not cause scandal or confusion", while also acknowledging the possibility of [[baptizing]] [[LGBT parenting|children]] of [[Catholic Church and homosexuality|same-sex couples]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/vatican-says-transgender-catholics-can-be-baptised/articleshow/105078037.cms (AFP via ''TOI'')]
